inspection_notes: Viewed both PMC image assets at native resolution and a 3x zoomed crop of every panel (fig1 a-f, fig2 a-c) plus 4x to 6x detail crops of the ventricle regions, the cord strip and the top edge of panel 1f. Descriptions state only visible content (plane, CSF brightness, bright foci positions as image-left or image-right, absence of arrows or markers, small text label and gray patch in 1f). Sequence names come from the captions, lesion significance only from case text. All panels attributed to p1 individually via the caption plus the case-text Figure 1 and Figure 2 citations; no identity or laterality inferred from pixels.
